newsitem.title: JAPAN: Rikadenki's OTC registration to be cancelled - JSDA.
newsitem.headline: Rikadenki's OTC registration to be cancelled - JSDA.

text.p: Rikadenki Kogyo Co Ltd's registration on the over-the-counter (OTC) market will be cancelled as of Thursday, the Japan Securities Dealers' Association (JSDA) said on Wednesday.

The decision came after banks suspended the measurement instruments maker's right to conduct new transactions on Wednesday after it failed to honour promissory notes for a second time, it said in a statement.
From Thursday, Rikadenki will be classified as a "managed issue", which would make inappropriate for securities houses to recommend its shares to investors, the JSDA said.
Separately, Rikadenki said on Wednesday it was setting up a programme to restructure its business and would announce the plan as soon as possible.
The company was not immediately available for comment.
The JSDA said a company can maintain its status as a managed issue for up to six months at first but needs to be screened every six months thereafter if it wants to maintain that status.
Once a company is classified as a managed issue, it has to reapply to be traded again as a normal OTC issue, it said.
